controls.requirement: The declarative oracle must not call the subject predicate functions.
Adversarial cases must be generated by mutation operators rather than copied fixture labels.
Expected outcomes must be derived from the explicit semantic requirements.
Replay order must be independently shuffled and normalized digests must be compared.
Every disagreement, invariant failure, malformed record, and missing artifact must be preserved.
No Notebook 23 or Notebook 24 result rows may be loaded or reused.
